name: handoff
description: Offers to carry a huge chat into a fresh one: when the context passes a threshold (or you run /refresh) it has the model write a handoff note, saves it under ~/.claude/handoffs, and lets you copy it or start a new chat with it.

thresholdTokens.title: Offer threshold (tokens)
thresholdTokens.description: When the chat holds at least this many tokens after a turn, offer a refresh (a handoff note and a fresh chat). Offered once per crossing.

snoozeTurns.title: Snooze after Not now (turns)
snoozeTurns.description: How many of your turns to stay quiet after you press Not now before offering again. 0 offers again after the next turn.

maxHandoffChars.title: Max handoff length (characters)
maxHandoffChars.description: Upper bound on the handoff note. The model is asked to stay under it and anything longer is cut.
